quote: While single-head attention is 0.9 BLEU worse than the best setting, quality also drops off with too many heads.
claim: 消融实验显示，单头注意力比最佳设置差 0.9 BLEU，头数过多时质量也会下降 [S6.SS2.p2]；减小注意力 key 维度 d_k 会损害模型质量 [S6.SS2.p3]；用学习式位置嵌入替换正弦位置编码结果几乎相同 [S6.SS2.p3]。

quote: The encoder is composed of a stack of $N=6$ identical layers. Each layer has two sub-layers.
claim: Transformer 沿用编码器-解码器结构，编码器和解码器各由 N=6 个相同层堆叠而成，每层包含多头自注意力与逐位置全连接前馈网络两个子层，并采用残差连接加层归一化 [S3.SS1.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

quote: This inherently sequential nature precludes parallelization within training examples, which becomes critical at longer sequence lengths
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：循环模型沿序列位置逐步计算，这种固有的顺序性阻碍了训练样本内部的并行化，在序列较长时尤为关键 [S1.p2]。

quote: the Transformer outperforms the BerkeleyParser even when training only on the WSJ training set of 40K sentences
claim: 在英语成分句法分析上，模型在仅用 WSJ 40K 句训练时也超过了 BerkeleyParser [S6.SS3.p5]。

quote: In this work we employ $h=8$ parallel attention layers, or heads. For each of these we use $d_{k}=d_{v}=d_{\text{model}}/h=64$.
claim: 其注意力采用缩放点积注意力，即对 query 与所有 key 的点积除以 sqrt(d_k) 后做 softmax 并加权求和 value [S3.SS2.SSS1.p1][S3.SS2.SSS1.p3]；多头注意力将 query、key、value 线性投影 h 次后并行执行注意力再拼接投影 [S3.SS2.SSS2.p1]，文中取 h=8、d_k=d_v=64 [S3.SS2.SSS2.p5]。

quote: Position embeddings are added to the patch embeddings to retain positional information.
claim: 位置信息通过标准可学习 1D 位置嵌入加入，编码器由多头自注意力和 MLP 交替组成，每个 block 前用 LayerNorm、后接残差连接 [S3.SS1.p3][S3.SS1.p4]。

quote: we reshape the image $\mathbf{x}\in\mathbb{R}^{H\times W\times C}$ into a sequence of flattened 2D patches $\mathbf{x}_{p}\in\mathbb{R}^{N\times(P^{2}\cdot C)}$
claim: 方法上，ViT 将图像 \(\mathbf{x}\in\mathbb{R}^{H\times W\times C}\) 切分为 \(N=HW/P^{2}\) 个 \(P\times P\) 的 patch，展平后经可训练线性投影映射到维度 \(D\)，得到 patch embeddings [S3.SS1.p1]。

quote: hybrids slightly outperform ViT at small computational budgets, but the difference vanishes for larger models.
claim: 缩放研究中，ViT 在性能/计算权衡上优于 ResNet，约用 2–4 倍更少计算达到相同性能，混合模型在小计算预算下略优于纯 ViT，但差距随模型增大消失 [S4.SS4.p2]。

quote: In vision, attention is either applied in conjunction with convolutional networks, or used to replace certain components of convolutional networks while keeping their overall structure in place.
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：在计算机视觉中卷积架构仍占主导，能否将标准 Transformer 直接应用于图像，而不依赖卷积网络或专门的注意力近似 [S1.p2][S1.p3]。作者指出，此前将自注意力用于图像的工作要么与 CNN 结合，要么替换

quote: The smaller ViT-L/16 model pre-trained on JFT-300M outperforms BiT-L (which is pre-trained on the same dataset) on all tasks, while requiring substantially less computational resources to train.
claim: 在 JFT-300M 上预训练的 ViT-L/16 在所有任务上超过同样预训练的 BiT-L，且所需计算资源显著更少；ViT-H/14 进一步提升，尤其在 ImageNet、CIFAR-100 和 VTAB 上 [S4.SS2.p2]。

quote: once retrieval had collapsed, the generator would learn to ignore the documents, and the RAG model would perform equivalently to BART.
claim: 作者指出，在故事生成等任务中检索组件可能“崩溃”，无论输入如何都检索相同文档，此时生成器学会忽略文档，RAG 表现与 BART 相当 [A8.p1]。

quote: RAG-Token performs better than RAG-Sequence on Jeopardy question generation, with both models outperforming BART on Q-BLEU-1.
claim: 在 Jeopardy 问题生成中，RAG-Token 优于 RAG-Sequence，且两者在 Q-BLEU-1 上均优于 BART；人工评估中 RAG 在 42.7% 的情况下比 BART 更符合事实，而 BART 仅在 7.1% 的情况下更符合事实 [S4.SS3.p1]。

quote: REALM and ORQA, two recently introduced models that combine masked language models with a differentiable retriever, have shown promising results, but have only explored open-domain extractive question answering.
claim: 已有结合参数与非参数记忆的模型（如 REALM、ORQA）仅探索了开放域抽取式问答，本文希望将这种混合记忆引入序列到序列模型 [S1.p1]。

quote: Evaluators indicated that BART was more factual than RAG in only 7.1% of cases, while RAG was more factual in 42.7% of cases
claim: 在 Jeopardy 问题生成中，RAG-Token 优于 RAG-Sequence，且两者在 Q-BLEU-1 上均优于 BART；人工评估中 RAG 在 42.7% 的情况下比 BART 更符合事实，而 BART 仅在 7.1% 的情况下更符合事实 [S4.SS3.p1]。

quote: FEVER requires classifying whether a natural language claim is supported or refuted by Wikipedia, or whether there is not enough information to decide.
claim: 评估覆盖开放域问答（NQ、TQA、WQ、CT）、抽象问答（MSMARCO NLG v2.1）、Jeopardy 问题生成和 FEVER 事实核查 [S3.SS1.p1][S3.SS2.p1][S3.SS3.p1][S3.SS4.p1]。

quote: such degradation is not caused by overfitting, and adding more layers to a suitably deep model leads to higher training error
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：当网络能够开始收敛后，随着深度增加会出现退化问题——准确率饱和并迅速下降，且该退化并非由过拟合引起，增加层数反而导致更高的训练误差 [S1.p3]。

quote: with the network depth increasing, accuracy gets saturated (which might be unsurprising) and then degrades rapidly
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：当网络能够开始收敛后，随着深度增加会出现退化问题——准确率饱和并迅速下降，且该退化并非由过拟合引起，增加层数反而导致更高的训练误差 [S1.p3]。

quote: The existence of this constructed solution indicates that a deeper model should produce no higher training error than its shallower counterpart.
claim: 作者指出，按构造存在一个解使更深模型不应比其较浅对应模型有更高训练误差，但实验表明现有求解器无法找到这样的解 [S1.p4]。

quote: Identity shortcut connections add neither extra parameter nor computational complexity.
claim: 该形式通过恒等映射的捷径连接实现，捷径连接不增加额外参数或计算复杂度，整个网络仍可用 SGD 端到端训练 [S1.p6]。

quote: The entire network can still be trained end-to-end by SGD with backpropagation
claim: 该形式通过恒等映射的捷径连接实现，捷径连接不增加额外参数或计算复杂度，整个网络仍可用 SGD 端到端训练 [S1.p6]。

quote: by constraining models to replicate human thought processes, their performance is inherently capped by the human-provided exemplars
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：如何在不依赖大量人工标注推理轨迹的情况下，激励大语言模型发展推理能力 [S1.p1][S1.p2]。

quote: we sample 16 outputs with a maximum length of 32,768 tokens before the 8.2k step and 65,536 tokens afterward.
claim: DeepSeek-R1-Zero 的训练设置包括学习率 3e-6、KL 系数 0.001、采样温度 1，每题采样 16 个输出，最大长度前期 32,768 tokens、后期 65,536 tokens，共训练 10,400 步 [S2.SS1.p3]。

quote: there remains room for further optimization in terms of token efficiency, as instances of excessive reasoning—manifested as overthinking—are still observed in response to simpler questions.
claim: 作者明确承认 DeepSeek-R1 存在多项能力局限：结构化输出能力仍不理想，且无法利用搜索引擎、计算器等工具提升输出表现 [S6.p3]；token 效率仍有优化空间，简单问题上仍观察到过度推理（overthinking）[S6.p4]；目前主要优化中英文，处理其他语言时可能出现语言混合 [S6.p5]；对提示敏感，few-shot 提示会持续降低其性能 [S6.p6]；由于评估耗时长影响 RL 效率，软件工程任务未大规模应用 RL，因此在该类基准上未较 DeepSeek-V3 展现巨大提升 [S6.p7]。

quote: We set the maximum generation length to 32,768 tokens for the models.
claim: 评估时最大生成长度设为 32,768 tokens，默认使用 pass@k 评估并以非零温度报告 pass@1 [A4.SS1.SSS0.Px4.p2]。

quote: it is sensitive to prompts. Few-shot prompting consistently degrades its performance.
claim: 作者明确承认 DeepSeek-R1 存在多项能力局限：结构化输出能力仍不理想，且无法利用搜索引擎、计算器等工具提升输出表现 [S6.p3]；token 效率仍有优化空间，简单问题上仍观察到过度推理（overthinking）[S6.p4]；目前主要优化中英文，处理其他语言时可能出现语言混合 [S6.p5]；对提示敏感，few-shot 提示会持续降低其性能 [S6.p6]；由于评估耗时长影响 RL 效率，软件工程任务未大规模应用 RL，因此在该类基准上未较 DeepSeek-V3 展现巨大提升 [S6.p7]。

quote: Training on our full data pool of 59K examples, a superset of s1K, does not offer substantial gains over our 1K selection
claim: 在数据消融中，随机选择、仅选最长推理轨迹或仅选最大多样性均导致显著更差性能（AIME24 平均约 -30%），而训练全部 59K 样本相比 1K 选择没有带来实质提升 [S1.p3]。

quote: We perform supervised fine-tuning (SFT) of an off-the-shelf pretrained model on our small dataset
claim: 方法包含两部分：一是构建 s1K 数据集，从 59K 问题池中依据质量、难度、多样性三个准则筛选出 1,000 个问题，并配以从 Gemini Thinking Experimental 蒸馏的推理轨迹 [S1.p2][S2.SS2.p1]。

quote: Thus, we ask: what is the simplest approach to achieve both test-time scaling and strong reasoning performance?
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：在众多 o1 复现尝试均未公开复现出清晰的测试时扩展行为的情况下，实现测试时扩展和强推理性能的最简单方法是什么 [S1.p1]。

quote: we go through three stages of filtering to arrive at a minimal set of 1,000 samples relying on our three guiding data principles: Quality, Difficulty, and Diversity
claim: 方法包含两部分：一是构建 s1K 数据集，从 59K 问题池中依据质量、难度、多样性三个准则筛选出 1,000 个问题，并配以从 Gemini Thinking Experimental 蒸馏的推理轨迹 [S1.p2][S2.SS2.p1]。

quote: It is an open question whether one can achieve their performance with just 1,000 samples
claim: 作者还提到，能否仅用 1,000 个样本达到 r1-32B 的性能仍是一个开放问题 [S4.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p1]。

quote: LIMO maintains competitive performance even on GPQA, where it achieves 70.7% accuracy, close to OpenAI-o1-preview’s leading score of 73.3%.
claim: 在分布外任务上，LIMO 在 OlympiadBench 达到 67.6%，高于 QwQ-32B-Preview 的 58.5% 和基座的 45.3%；在 CHMath 为 84.2% 对 68.5%，GradeSchool 为 76.2% 对 63.8%；在 GPQA 达到 70.7%，接近 OpenAI-o1-preview 的 73.3% [S6.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p1]。

quote: NuminaMath-100k, a randomly selected 100k subset of NuminaMath-CoT
claim: 对比基线包括 OpenAI-o1-preview、QwQ-32B-Preview、Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct，以及用 OpenThoughts-114k 和 NuminaMath-100k 微调的模型 [S6.SS1.p1][S6.SS1.p2]。

quote: We evaluate performance using the pass@1 metric in a zero-shot chain-of-thought setting across all benchmarks.
claim: 评估采用零样本思维链下的 pass@1 指标，大基准使用贪心解码单样本，小于 50 题的小基准生成 4 个样本并计算无偏 pass@1，最大输出长度 32,768 token [S5.SS0.SSS0.Px3.p1]。

quote: We fine-tune Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct using supervised fine-tuning on our LIMO dataset.
claim: 训练上，作者对 Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct 进行全参数监督微调，使用 DeepSpeed ZeRO-3 和 FlashAttention-2，学习率 5.0e-6，余弦衰减，无 warmup，训练 15 个 epoch，batch size 为 64 [S4.p2]。

quote: the American Invitational Mathematics Examination (AIME24), MATH500, and the American Mathematics Competitions (AMC23).
claim: 论文在域内基准 AIME24、MATH500 和 AMC23 上评估模型 [S5.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

quote: about half ( $52.0$ %) of unresolved instances fall into the Incorrect Implementation or Overly Specific Implementation categories
claim: 行为分析发现，智能体通常先复现和/或定位问题，之后主要是“编辑再执行”循环 [S5.SS2.p2][S5.SS2.p3]；2,294 个任务实例中有 1,185 个（51.7%）的轨迹出现至少一次失败编辑 [S5.SS2.p4]；成功运行比不成功运行完成更早、成本更低 [S5.SS2.p5]；约一半（52.0%）未解决实例属于错误实现或过度特定实现 [S5.SS2.p6]。

quote: Without SWE-agent’s file editor interface, performance drops to ( $10.3$ % $\downarrow$ 7.7).
claim: 消融显示，没有搜索工具时性能为 15.7%，迭代搜索反而降至 12.0%；没有文件编辑器时降至 10.3%；没有 linting 时降至 15.0% [S5.SS1.p3][S5.SS1.p4][S5.SS1.p5]。

quote: (1) manually inspect agent behavior to identify difficulties and propose improvements, and (2) run a grid search to select the best ACI configuration.
claim: 设计方法上，作者假设 LM 固定，专注于设计 ACI，通过人工检查智能体行为发现问题并提出改进，以及网格搜索选择最佳 ACI 配置 [S2.p4]。

quote: In practice, we find that LM agents can struggle to reliably take actions in this environment.
claim: 作者指出，LM 智能体直接与 Linux shell 交互时难以可靠地采取行动，例如无法提供编辑小段文件的简单命令，且无效编辑没有反馈，这些缺陷严重妨碍性能，从而促使设计 ACI [S1.p2]。

quote: We argue that LM agents represent a new category of end user, with their own needs and abilities.
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：LM 智能体在更复杂的软件工程任务上尚未被充分探索，而现有界面（如 Linux shell）是为人类用户设计的，LM 智能体作为一类新的终端用户可能有不同需求，因此需要研究界面设计如何影响 LM 智能体的表现 [S1.p1][S2.p1]。

quote: on GSM8K, Quiet-STaR results in a 5.0% boost over the base model
claim: 在 OpenWebMath 上训练后，Quiet-STaR 在 CommonsenseQA 上比基础模型提升 10.9%，在 GSM8K 上提升 5.0%，且提升随理由 token 数量增加而持续增大 [S5.SS1.p1]。

quote: we introduce an auxiliary ‘rationale’ variable between each pair of observed tokens of the sequence
claim: Quiet-STaR 在每对观测 token 之间引入辅助的理由变量，目标是让模型生成中间思考以更好地预测后续序列 [S3.p1]。

quote: On CommonsenseQA, we find that Quiet-STaR improves performance by 10.9% compared to the base language model.
claim: 在 OpenWebMath 上训练后，Quiet-STaR 在 CommonsenseQA 上比基础模型提升 10.9%，在 GSM8K 上提升 5.0%，且提升随理由 token 数量增加而持续增大 [S5.SS1.p1]。

quote: In the current implementation we do not support dynamically predicting when to generate, or end, a rationale.
claim: Quiet-STaR 带来显著开销，在生成每个额外 token 前都要生成许多 token [S6.p2]。

quote: We perform most of our experiments by training on OpenWebMath, a crawl that emphasizes more technical webpages.
claim: 大部分实验在 OpenWebMath 上训练，作者预期该语料包含更高密度的需要推理的 token [S5.p2]。

quote: However, when interacting with LLMs, users and developers often restrict models to making only one attempt when solving a problem.
claim: 其动机在于，尽管训练计算扩展持续提升模型能力，但推理时用户和开发者通常只允许模型对一个问题进行一次尝试 [S1.p2]。

quote: 1. The relationship between coverage and the number of samples can often be modelled with an exponentiated power law. 2. For a given task, the coverage curves of different models from the same family resemble S-curves with similar slopes but distinct horizontal offsets.
claim: 覆盖率与样本数的关系常可用指数幂律建模，且同一模型家族的覆盖率曲线在水平平移后形状相似 [S3.p2]。

quote: Our results from Section 4 highlight the importance of improving sample verification methods when tools for automatically doing so are unavailable.
claim: 此外，在缺乏自动验证器的领域，常见验证方法（多数投票和奖励模型）无法随样本预算扩展，需要改进样本验证方法 [S5.p5]。

quote: 1) We generate many independent candidate solutions for a given problem by sampling from an LLM with a positive temperature. 2) We use a domain-specific verifier (ex. unit tests for code) to select a final answer from the generated samples.
claim: 论文采用重复采样方法：对每个问题，以正温度从语言模型独立生成大量候选解，然后使用领域特定的验证器（如代码的单元测试）从样本中选择最终答案 [S1.F1]。

quote: On CodeContests, the coverage of Gemma-2B increases by over 300x, from a pass@1 of 0.02% to a pass@10k of 7.1%. Similarly, when solving MATH problems with Pythia-160M, coverage increases from a pass@1 of 0.27% to a pass@10k of 57%.
claim: 覆盖率随样本数增加而平滑提升，在多个任务和模型上均成立；例如 Gemma-2B 在 CodeContests 上从 pass@1 的 0.02% 提升到 pass@10k 的 7.1%，Pythia-160M 在 MATH 上从 0.27% 提升到 57% [S2.SS2.p3]。

quote: Here we show that scaling up language models greatly improves task-agnostic, few-shot performance
claim: 作者指出，人类通常只需少量示例或简单指令就能完成新的语言任务，而当前 NLP 系统仍难以做到这一点 [abstract]。

quote: in the the few-shot setting is sometimes competitive with or even occasionally surpasses state-of-the-art
claim: 在 NLP 任务上，GPT-3 在零样本和单样本设置下取得有希望的结果，少样本设置下有时可与最先进的微调模型竞争甚至偶尔超越 [S1.p11]。

quote: For all tasks, GPT-3 is applied without any gradient updates or fine-tuning, with tasks and few-shot demonstrations specified purely via text interaction with the model.
claim: 评估时模型不进行任何梯度更新或微调，任务和少样本示例完全通过文本交互指定，分为零样本、单样本和少样本三种设置 [abstract][S2.p2]。

quote: our experiments do not include any bidirectional architectures or other training objectives such as denoising
claim: 作者指出，由于只研究自回归语言模型，未包含双向架构或其他训练目标，这可能以牺牲某些任务性能为代价 [S5.p3]。

quote: which include unscrambling words, performing arithmetic, and using novel words in a sentence after seeing them defined only once
claim: GPT-3 还在需要即时推理或快速适应的任务上表现出单样本和少样本能力，包括打乱单词、算术运算和仅见一次定义后使用新词 [S1.p12]。

quote: On MMLU, in line with English MMLU results shown above, Llama 3 405B falls behind GPT-4o by 2%.
claim: Llama 3 405B 在 MMLU 上落后 GPT-4o 约 2%，但在 MGSM 上平均达到 91.6%，优于大多数其他模型 [S5.SS2.SSS4.p4]。

quote: We train separate encoders for images and speech.
claim: 多模态扩展采用组合式方法，分别训练图像编码器、语音编码器以及相应的适配器，将多模态信息集成到语言模型中 [S2.p5]。

quote: We also perform experiments in which we add image, video, and speech capabilities to Llama 3 using a compositional approach.
claim: 此外，论文还探索通过组合式方法将图像、视频和语音能力集成到 Llama 3 中 [S2.p4]。

quote: Our experimental evaluation suggests that our flagship model performs on par with leading language models such as GPT-4 across a variety of tasks, and is close to matching the state-of-the-art.
claim: 论文旨在开发一套新的基础模型 Llama 3，使其原生支持多语言、编程、推理和工具使用，并在广泛任务上达到与领先语言模型相当的质量 [S1.p3][S1.p6]。

quote: Table 16 contains an overview of all the benchmarks, organized by the capability.
claim: 后训练模型在 MMLU、MMLU-Pro、IFEval、GSM8K、MATH、GPQA、HumanEval、MBPP、MultiPL-E、MGSM 等基准上进行了评估，并进行了广泛的人类评估 [S5.SS2.p2][S5.SS3.p1]。

quote: we conducted extensive experiments across a diverse range of datasets.

claim: 论文旨在解决自编码器的图像重建问题，因为当前自编码器存在研究目标不是数据重建而是特征表示、数据恢复性能评估被忽视、纯自编码器甚至纯深度学习难以实现无损数据重建等不足 [abstract]。

quote: For each residue position, the tool outputs the overall tolerance to mutations without altering the backbone structure (perplexity) and individual amino acid probabilities.
claim: AntiFold 是一个抗体特异性逆折叠模型，从 ESM-IF1 微调而来，输入解析或预测的抗体可变域结构，对每个残基位置输出突变耐受性（perplexity）和各个氨基酸的概率 [S1.p6]。

quote: CDRH3 AAR was improved through use of a span-masking scheme (36.4%), additional masking of random residues (53.2%), weighting masking towards CDR residues with a 3:1 weight (53.3%), layer-wise learning-rate decay (54.4%) and including predicted structures from OAS (58.4%) (Tables S1 -3).
claim: 微调中采用了 span masking、随机残基额外掩码、以 3:1 权重偏向 CDR 残基的掩码、逐层学习率衰减，以及纳入 OAS 预测结构等策略 [S2.SS2.p1]。

quote: AntiFold demonstrated a substantial improvement in AAR on the experimental structure test set as compared to the original ESM-IF1 model (60 vs 43% AAR for CDRH3, p $<$ 0.005
claim: 在实验结构测试集上，AntiFold 的 CDRH3 氨基酸恢复率显著高于原始 ESM-IF1（60% vs 43%，p < 0.005），并在 CDRH3（60% vs 56%）、其余 CDR 区域（75-84% vs 63-76%）和多数 FR 区域（87-94% vs 85-89%）上优于 AbMPNN [S3.SS1.p1]。

quote: Additionally, ProteinMPNN-based tools have features such as the occasional re-ordering of antibody chains or CDRH3 position 112 insertions, or the introduction of gaps into IMGT numbered antibodies, incompatible with antibody structures.
claim: 论文要解决的是抗体设计中如何在保持骨架结构及结构相关性质的前提下选择突变，因为现有逆折叠工具在 CDR 区域的序列恢复能力有限，且基于 ProteinMPNN 的工具存在链重排、CDRH3 第 112 位插入或引入 gap 等与抗体结构不兼容的问题 [S1.p5]。

quote: We also hold out a set of 100 pockets from the training data for evaluating the model performance.
claim: 预训练使用 Uni-Mol 作者提出的大规模 3D 分子数据集，包含 12M 分子的 208M 个构象和 3.2M 个蛋白质口袋空间结构 [S4.p2]。

quote: BindGPT is the first model capable of modeling hydrogen explicitly at such large scale.
claim: 预训练的 BindGPT 在不使用和显式使用氢原子的设置下都持续优于 XYZ-TF 基线，并且是首个能在如此大规模下显式建模氢原子的模型 [S4.SS1.p3]。

quote: Finally, we use the Platinum dataset as a hold-out evaluation dataset to test our model and baselines on zero-shot conformer generation.
claim: 预训练使用 Uni-Mol 作者提出的大规模 3D 分子数据集，包含 12M 分子的 208M 个构象和 3.2M 个蛋白质口袋空间结构 [S4.p2]。

quote: For conformer generation, we compare BindGPT with the current state-of-the-art methods, Torsional Diffusion and the Uni-Mol model.
claim: 对比基线包括 EDM、MolDiff、XYZ-Transformer、Torsional Diffusion、Uni-Mol、TargetDiff 和 Pocket2Mol [S4.SS1.p2][S4.SS2.p2]。

quote: To align these two formats we enforce to have the same atom ordering in both. We also remove the atom symbol from the XYZ representation as it already was shown in SMILES.
claim: 为消除对外部图重建工具的依赖，作者将 XYZ 格式与 SMILES 格式耦合，强制两种格式中原子顺序一致，并从 XYZ 表示中移除原子符号 [S3.SS1.p2]。

quote: A remarkable agreement is achieved with an MAE of only $2.47\text{\,}\mathrm{GPa}$.
claim: 声子最大频率 MAE 为 0.87 THz，0 K 体模量 MAE 为 2.47 GPa [S2.SS2.p3][S2.SS2.p4]。

quote: At the core of this paradigm shift is the ability to accurately and efficiently predict the properties of arbitrary materials under practical synthesis and working conditions.
claim: 作者指出，准确高效地预测任意材料在实际合成和工作条件下的性质，是材料设计数字化转型的核心挑战 [S1.p1]。

quote: with only 30 configurations sampled from an ab initio molecular dynamics (AIMD) trajectory with rev-PBE0-D3 level of theory, MatterSim can be efficiently fine-tuned and the resultant model (indicated as finetune-30 model) reaches the same performance as the model trained from scratch with all 900 configurations
claim: 通过微调，仅需 30 个构型即可达到从头训练 900 个构型的性能，数据效率提升 30 倍 [S2.SS4.p2]。

quote: the current model is trained only on homogeneous bulk systems, without explicit inclusion of surface and interface data that are crucial for applications such as catalysis
claim: 作者指出，MatterSim 目前使用半局域原子相互作用描述，在长程相互作用主导的场景（如聚合物和多相系统）中表现不佳 [S3.p3]。

quote: MatterSim employs an active learning approach to explore the extensive materials space, integrating a deep graph neural network, a materials explorer, a first-principles supervisor, and an ensemble uncertainty monitor
claim: MatterSim 采用主动学习框架，整合深度图神经网络、材料探索器、第一性原理监督器和集成不确定性监测器，从已有数据出发迭代采样并标注能量、力和应力 [S2.SS1.p1]。

quote: the root mean squared deviation (RMSD) from the starting state remains relatively constant until 3,000 ps, corresponding to a temperature of 800 K.
claim: MOF-5 在 800 K 下 RMSD 到约 3,000 ps 仍相对稳定，之后框架显著降解 [S3.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

quote: Diffusion pretraining helps universally with improvements between 17% and 70%, even on Alexandria, which is an order of magnitude larger MPtraj.
claim: 扩散预训练普遍带来改进，改进幅度在 17% 到 70% 之间，即使在数据量大一个数量级的 Alexandria 上也是如此 [S3.F2]。

quote: it is hard to make a robust judgement of superiority from a sample size of four simulations.
claim: 作者指出，零样本 MD17 评估仅基于四个模拟，样本量小，难以稳健判断优劣；加入 Alexandria 反而降低性能这一结果在更大分子样本上可能并不显著 [S3.SS4.SSSx2.Px2.p1]。

quote: This adjustment is only applied to non-pbc systems, and is implemented by minimizing a Lagrangian incorporating these two constraints.
claim: 由于模型非保守、直接预测力，作者在推理时施加净零力和净扭矩移除调整 [S2.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p2][S2.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p5]。

quote: Comparing just those models trained on MPtraj, we see that Orb has the best performance, with a lower $h(r)$ across the board.
claim: 在 MD17-10k 上，系统专用 Orb 对四种分子均达到最大 300 ps 稳定性，与 NequIP 相当并领先其他基线 [S3.SS4.SSSx1.Px1.p1]；零样本评估中 Orb (MPtraj) 的 h(r) 全面低于其他模型 [S3.SS4.SSSx2.Px1.p1]。

quote: We characterize our surface code logical performance by fitting the logical error per cycle $\varepsilon_{d}$ up to 250 cycles
claim: 表面码逻辑性能通过拟合最多250个纠错周期的逻辑错误率来表征，并平均9个距离-3子网格和4个距离-5子网格 [S2.p5]。

quote: the syndrome information produced by the quantum device must be decoded as fast as it is generated.
claim: 此外，容错量子计算还要求系统在数小时时间尺度上保持稳定，并实时解码综合征信息 [S1.p2]。

quote: We begin with results from our 105-qubit processor depicted in Fig. 1 a.
claim: 实验在105量子比特和72量子比特超导transmon处理器上进行，运行距离-3、-5、-7表面码以及距离-29重复码 [S2.p1][S4.p2]。

quote: we measure logical performance of one distance-5 and four distance-3 codes 16 times over 15 hours
claim: 作者还进行了相干错误注入实验，以及15小时内重复16次的稳定性测试 [S3.p1][S3.p5]。

quote: One is a neural network decoder, and the other is a harmonized ensemble of correlated minimum-weight perfect matching decoders augmented with matching synthesis.
claim: 解码方面使用两类离线高精度解码器：神经网络解码器和增强匹配合成的关联最小权重完美匹配解码器集成，并针对器件噪声进行微调 [S2.p2]。

quote: The 68% credible-interval results for these parameters are $\left.\begin{aligned} \Omega_{\mathrm{m}}&=0.295\pm 0.015,\\ r_{\mathrm{d}}h&=(101.8\pm 1.3)\,\text{Mpc},\end{aligned}\ \right\}\ \ \mbox{\text{\parbox{42.67912pt}{\begin{flushleft}DESI~BAO, \end{flushleft}}}}$ (15)
claim: DESI BAO数据单独与平坦ΛCDM一致，给出Ωm=0.295±0.015和r_d h=(101.8±1.3) Mpc [S4.SS1.p1]。

quote: In this paper, we report the constraints derived from the measurements of baryon acoustic oscillations with the first year of data from DESI as part of a larger series of papers.
claim: 论文旨在利用DESI第一年观测的BAO测量，在多个红移区间内约束宇宙学参数，并检验标准ΛCDM模型及扩展模型 [S1.p8]。

quote: The cause of this difference is not clear.
claim: DESI与SDSS在0.6<z<0.8红移区间的BAO测量存在约3σ差异，原因尚不清楚，可能是样本方差涨落 [S3.SS3.p4][S3.SS3.p5]。

quote: When running cobaya, we rely on the Boltzmann code CAMB for theoretical cosmology calculations.
claim: 使用cobaya进行贝叶斯推断，结合CAMB计算理论宇宙学，并采用MCMC采样 [S2.SS5.p1][S2.SS5.p2][S2.SS5.p3]。

quote: We find $\left.\begin{aligned} \Omega_{\mathrm{m}}&=0.293\pm 0.015,\\ w&=-0.99^{+0.15}_{-0.13},\end{aligned}\ \right\}\ \ \mbox{\text{\parbox{42.67912pt}{\begin{flushleft}DESI~BAO, \end{flushleft}}}}$ (25)
claim: 在w CDM模型中，DESI BAO单独给出w=-0.99^{+0.15}_{-0.13} [S5.SS1.p3]。

quote: There is no need for additional stellar emission or AGN scattered light.
claim: 作者提出一个 LRD 的 SED 模型：假设典型 AGN 入射辐射被嵌入延展尘埃介质，其消光律类似猎户座星云或某些 AGN 环境，紫外-光学谱由尘埃衰减的 AGN 辐射描述，无需额外恒星辐射或 AGN 散射光 [S1.p6]。

quote: However, this extremely red SED color does not match the JWST MIRI photometric data for LRDs, which suggest a modest red color or even a flat spectral shape.
claim: 在红外，当尘埃密度高（n0≳10^3 cm^-3）或分布高度集中（γ=1-2）时，近红外发射过亮，与 MIRI 数据不符；而较低密度（n0=10、100 cm^-3）且 γ<1 时，SED 从光学到 2-3 μm 与观测一致，能量峰移到中远红外 [S3.p7][S3.p8][S3.p10]。

quote: Those observations appear to contradict expectations that the SED should be very red throughout the optical to NIR spectrum due to re-emission from hot dust components heated by the AGNs.
claim: 作者指出，MIRI 观测显示多数 LRD 未被 F1800W 探测到，且探测到的源 SED 从静止系光学到近红外趋于平坦，这与热尘埃再发射导致的极红 SED 预期相矛盾，也使尘埃遮蔽 AGN 情景受到质疑 [S1.p3]。

quote: These results agree well to the mean value of the dust mass $\langle M_{\rm dust}\rangle\simeq 1.6^{+4.8}_{-0.9}\times 10^{4}~M_{\odot}$ estimated using NIRCam images of LRDs.
claim: 此外，模型估计的尘埃质量与 NIRCam 图像估计值相符 [S4.SS1.p6]。

quote: As reference, we overlay photometric SED data obtained from stacking LRD samples at $z\sim 5.5$ (orange) and $z=7.5$ (blue).
claim: 作者将模型 SED 与 LRD 的堆叠测光数据比较，包括 z~5.5 和 z=7.5 的样本，以及 JADES 和 COSMOS-Web 的堆叠数据 [S2.p5][S3.p6]。

quote: It is important to note that close to the threshold, non-relativistic QCD processes, such as Coulomb bound state effects, affect the production of $t\bar{t}$ events and are not accounted for in the MC generators.
claim: 在阈值附近，非相对论 QCD 过程（如库仑束缚态效应）会影响 t\bar{t} 事件产生，而蒙特卡洛产生器未考虑这些效应 [S1.SS4.p2]。

quote: This analysis focuses on the data sample recorded using single-electron or single-muon triggers.
claim: 分析使用 ATLAS 探测器在 2015–2018 年收集的质心能量 √s = 13 TeV、积分亮度 140 fb⁻¹ 的完整质子-质子碰撞数据集，聚焦于单电子或单缪子触发记录的数据样本 [S1.SS1.p1]。

quote: It is reported in a fiducial phase space defined with stable particles to minimize the uncertainties that stem from limitations of the Monte Carlo event generators and the parton shower model in modeling top-quark pair production.
claim: 论文通过测量单一观测量 D 来探测自旋纠缠，D 由母顶夸克和反顶夸克静止系中带电轻子之间的夹角推断，定义为 D = −3·⟨cos φ⟩ [abstract][S1.p9]。

quote: The complete data set of $pp$ collision events at a center-of-mass energy of $\sqrt{s}=$13\text{\,}\mathrm{TeV}$$ collected with the ATLAS experiment during 2015–2018 is used, corresponding to an integrated luminosity of 140 fb -1.
claim: 分析使用 ATLAS 探测器在 2015–2018 年收集的质心能量 √s = 13 TeV、积分亮度 140 fb⁻¹ 的完整质子-质子碰撞数据集，聚焦于单电子或单缪子触发记录的数据样本 [S1.SS1.p1]。

quote: The observed result in the region with $340<m_{t\bar{t}}<380$ GeV establishes the formation of entangled $t\bar{t}$ states. This constitutes the first observation of entanglement in a quark–antiquark pair.
claim: 在信号区，相对于纠缠极限的观测和预期显著性均远超五个标准差，且不依赖于用于将纠缠极限修正到基准相空间的蒙特卡洛模型 [S1.SS4.p4]。

quote: The quantum capacitance, $C_{\mathrm{\scriptscriptstyle Q}}$, of dot 2 is read out through dispersive gate sensing using an off-chip resonator circuit in a reflectometry setup.
claim: 作者采用色散栅极探测三量子点干涉仪（TQDI）的方法，其中三个量子点与 1DTS 构成一个被通量穿过的环路，通过测量中间量子点（dot 2）的量子电容来读取宇称 [S2.p3]。

quote: From the histograms, we extract an achieved SNR of $4.9$ in $90\text{\,}\mathrm{\SIUnitSymbolMicro s}$ ( Fig. 3 g,h) or, equivalently, an SNR of $1$ in $3.7\text{\,}\mathrm{\SIUnitSymbolMicro s}$
claim: 作者观察到量子电容随通量呈现 h/2e 周期的双模分布，并伴随随机电报信号，在 90 μs 内信噪比达到 4.9，等效于 3.7 μs 内信噪比为 1 [S3.p3]。

quote: By itself, this measurement does not unequivocally distinguish between MZMs in the topological phase and fine-tuned low-energy Andreev bound states in the trivial phase
claim: 作者指出，该测量本身不能唯一区分拓扑 MZM 与平庸 Andreev 束缚态，但将后者需满足的性质限制得很紧 [S1.p3][S5.p1]。

quote: Finally, we repeat the interferometry measurement at a low field ( $0.8\text{\,}\mathrm{T}$), where the device is well within the trivial phase, and the induced gap in the nanowire has not closed yet.
claim: 此外还进行了准粒子注入、断开量子点与纳米线、以及低场（0.8 T）对照实验 [S3.p12][S3.p13][S3.p14]。

quote: Protocols for measurement-only topological quantum computation simplify these operations, reducing them to fusion alone.
claim: 论文要解决的问题是如何在拓扑超导纳米线中实现费米宇称的投影测量，这是基于测量-only 拓扑量子计算的关键操作 [S1.p1][S1.p2]。

quote: Our results lend some credence to that hypothesis, but it remains possible other effects such as system size and the lack of interfaces may contribute.
claim: 作者认为这些结果在一定程度上支持了“经典势粘度偏移源于熔点被低估”的假说，但仍可能存在体系大小和缺乏界面等其他因素 [S4.p2]。

quote: We begin by comparing the viscosity measurements from the three computational models to experimental data in Figure 1.
claim: 作者将三种模型计算的粘度与实验粘度数据进行比较，温度范围覆盖熔点以上的液态区间 [S3.p1]。

quote: The results for the MACE model agree well with the experimental data across the temperature axis, unlike the known offset for the Buckingham and BHM models
claim: MACE 模型计算的粘度在整个温度轴上与实验数据吻合良好，而 Buckingham 和 BHM 模型存在已知的温度偏移，模拟粘度约在比实验高 300 K 的温度处才与实验值匹配 [S3.p1]。

quote: this understanding is hindered by a poor theoretical understanding of the liquid state, and the inadequacy of classical atomistic models in generating faithful thermophysical data.
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：经典原子模型难以生成可靠的熔融盐热物理数据，且此前 Buckingham 势对熔融 LiF 粘度的预测存在明显的温度偏移 [S1.p2][S1.p3]。

quote: Here we report the accuracy of viscosity values calculated using the MACE potential against experimental viscosity data.
claim: 作者希望借助快速发展的机器学习原子间势（MLIPs）改进对熔融 LiF 的分子动力学描述，并报告 MACE 势计算粘度相对于实验数据的准确性 [S1.p4]。

quote: When considering only ACF-valid samples (right panel), The errors are comparable, with LightPred error slightly lower than ACF error.
claim: 在 Kepler 数据上，模型预测了全部样本，而 ACF 和 GPS 仅有效预测约 85% 的样本；在 ACF 有效子集上两者误差相当，但模型整体误差更低 [S5.SS1.p2][S5.SS2.SSS2.p2]。

quote: For a subset of valid predictions, we see that the performance of ACF is comparable to our model in terms of acc10p and acc20p but our model shows significantly lower average error.
claim: 在模拟数据上，LightPred 在噪声和无噪声样本上的表现均优于 Tel-Aviv 团队报告的 ACF 结果；在有效预测子集上，ACF 的 acc10p 和 acc20p 与模型相当，但模型平均误差显著更低，而 GPS 在所有方面均不如模型 [S5.SS1.p2]。

quote: This left us with 130868 which serves both for the SSL step and the inference.
claim: 在 Kepler 数据上，作者对 130868 个样本进行预测，经筛选后得到 108096 个样本用于误差分析，并最终生成 82771 条可靠预测 [S5.SS2.p1][S5.SS2.SSS1.p1][S5.SS3.p2]。

quote: these methods often struggle with complex light curves that exhibit multiple periodicities or evolving spot patterns.
claim: 论文旨在利用深度学习从 Kepler 光变曲线中测量恒星自转周期，以应对经典方法在大数据集上耗时、难以处理多周期或演化黑子图案的复杂光变曲线的问题 [S1.p2]。

quote: Global branch - here we follow the recent work of called Astroconformer.
claim: LightPred 采用双分支架构：时间分支以 Diff-ACF 为输入，包含卷积嵌入块、双向 LSTM 块和非可学习自注意力块；全局分支以 Diff-Lc 为输入，使用修改版 AstroConformer 块 [S3.SS1.p2][S3.SS1.p3]。
